test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 7

questions.question: If 180 : y :: y : 45, then find the positive value of y.
The speed of a bus is 5 metres/second. The distance (in kilometres) travelled by the bus in 8 hours and 40 minutes is:
A notebook is listed at ₹208 with a discount of 25%. What additional percentage discount must be offered to the customer to bring the net price to ₹117?
Shivam has borrowed an amount of ₹3,00,000 from a bank to start a business. How much simple interest (in ₹) will he pay at a rate of 6% per annum after 3 years?
The average of 11 numbers is 61. If the average of the first 6 numbers is 65 and that of the last 6 is 61, find the 6th number.
₹4,869 is divided among A, B, C, and D in such a way that the shares of A and B, B and C, and C and D are in the ratios of 4 : 5, 4 : 5, and 6 : 7, respectively. The share of A (in ₹) is:
Nirmal’s sale went up by 4% in the first year, and by 25% in the second year, to reach the present sale of ₹2,02,800. What was his sale (in ₹) two years ago?
P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 6 hours. If P alone can fill the same amount of water in 18 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill the same amount of water?

The list price of an article is ₹5,700 and a discount of 6% is offered on the list price. What additional discount percent on the already discounted price must be offered to a customer to bring the net selling price to ₹1,875.30?
A class of 30 students appeared in a test. The average score of 12 students is 70, and that of the rest is 66. What is the average score of the class?

A man purchased two varieties of apples at the rate of ₹2 for 3 apples and ₹6 per apple, respectively. If he purchased an equal number of apples of each variety and then sold all his apples at ₹6 per apple, what was his profit percentage?

A, B and C, when each is working alone, can do a piece of work in, respectively, 11, 88 and 24 days. They all started the work together, but A left after 4 days. In how many days, was the remaining work completed?
4% of a number is approximately what percentage of 12% of the same number?
Jaspreet deposited a sum of ₹18,725 at 20% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. The total amount (in ₹) received by Jaspreet after 2 years is:
A man is walking at a speed of 6 km/hr. After every kilometre he takes rest for 3 minutes. How much time will he take to cover a distance of 18 km?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (3 hours 51 minutes) है।

questions.question: The areas of three adjacent faces of a solid cuboid are 150 cm2, 99 cm2 and 66 cm2. What is the volume (in cm3) of the cuboid?
Which of the following is divisible by 7 and 12?
A car travels 163 km in the first hour and 117 km in the second hour. What is the average speed (in km/h) of the car for the whole journey?3522

The prices of three types of rice, P, Q, and R, are ₹280, ₹180, and ₹100 per kg, respectively. Subrata buys rice of each type in the ratio 3 : 4 : 3. If he spends a total of ₹6045, how many kilograms of type Q rice did he purchase?
A man buys a second-hand car for ₹1,05,000 and spends ₹43,000 on its repairs. What should be its selling price if he wants to earn an 11% profit?1962
